summary: Microsoft's open-city arcade racing series, from Angel Studios' Windows games through DICE's Xbox sequel and its mobile adaptations.

entries.title: Midtown Madness

emulation.notes: Use compatibility fixes for modern Windows if needed.

primary.why: The first Midtown Madness was released for Windows only, with an open-world Chicago recreation, multiple race/free-roam modes, LAN/Internet multiplayer, and unlockable vehicles. Windows is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a modern compatibility setup or period PC hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original MSN Gaming Zone matchmaking was retired; multiplayer now depends on LAN/DirectPlay-compatible preservation setups.

entries.title: Midtown Madness 2

emulation.notes: Use compatibility fixes for modern Windows if needed.

primary.why: Midtown Madness 2 is a Windows-only sequel adding London and San Francisco, more races, Crash Course activities, DirectPlay multiplayer, and more vehicles. Windows is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a modern compatibility setup or period PC hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: MSN Gaming Zone support ended; online play depends on DirectPlay-compatible preservation alternatives.

entries.title: Midtown Madness 3
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox release plus free DLC packs where preserved

emulation.notes: Use original hardware for best compatibility; verify emulator status and DLC support.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox output or emulator scaling

primary.version: Original Xbox release with DLC if preserved
primary.why: Midtown Madness 3 was built for Xbox with Paris and Washington, D.C., Xbox Live modes, split-screen, licensed vehicles, and free DLC car/track packs. The Xbox version is the full-fidelity route; mobile versions are separate 2D/3D adaptations.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or a compatible Xbox emulator; install preserved free DLC packs if available and use Insignia where online preservation is desired.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original Xbox Live ended; online play now depends on replacement-service preservation, and DLC access depends on preserved files/entitlements.
